hook: Android apps running with no Android at all

beats.say: Winedroid is a reimplementation of Android written entirely in Rust. It runs real APK files downloaded from F-Droid without Android underneath.
A browser demo loads a twelve megabyte WebAssembly runtime and runs apps like a calculator, a file explorer, a meditation timer and a weather app.
It's early. Not every app works yet, and the web build is slower because the JIT doesn't run in the browser, so native Winedroid is smoother.
